description: This file defines the PHP class 'ViewDisplaydeploy', which extends 'SugarView'. Its purpose is to handle the display of a deployment progress page within the SuiteCRM Module Builder interface. It constructs a Smarty template with deployment information, updates breadcrumbs via Ajax, and outputs JavaScript for front-end interaction.

classes.name: ViewDisplaydeploy
classes.description: Defines a view class responsible for rendering the deployment progress page within the SuiteCRM Module Builder. It builds a Smarty template, manages breadcrumbs, and outputs necessary JavaScript for the front end.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes AJAX breadcrumbs, assigns Smarty template variables, and outputs deployment progress JavaScript.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Provides the module title parameters for page display, including module name and title.
